title: Clear the desktop sync cache
steps: Ask the user to quit the desktop app.
Delete the local sync cache folder from Settings > Advanced > Reset cache.
Start the app and let it re-index; confirm the stuck folders complete.

title: Allow for identity provider clock skew
steps: Open Admin > Security > SSO for the workspace.
Set the allowed clock skew to 120 seconds.
Ask the customer's IT team to resync the identity provider clock, then test one login.

title: Re-save the webhook with the new signing secret
steps: Open Admin > Integrations > Webhooks and confirm the signing secret was rotated.
Have the customer update their endpoint with the new secret and re-save the webhook.
Replay the failed deliveries from the delivery log.

title: Run the export as a chunked background job
steps: Confirm the export exceeds the single-file limit.
Start the export from Admin > Data > Chunked export.
Send the customer the download page link when the job completes.

title: Revoke stale device push tokens
steps: Open the user's profile > Devices.
Revoke every push token registered before the reinstall.
Ask the user to sign out and in on the phone so a new token is registered; send a test mention.

title: Remove the domain from the email suppression list
steps: Search the email suppression list for the invitees' domain.
Remove the suppression entry created by the earlier bounce.
Resend the invitations and confirm delivery in the mail log.

title: Re-issue the API key on the new plan's rate tier
steps: Check the API key's rate tier; keys keep the old tier after an upgrade.
Re-issue the key from Admin > API so it takes the new tier.
Have the customer swap the key and rerun the integration.

title: Correct the device time zone
steps: Ask each affected user to open their device date and time settings.
Set the time zone manually to their real location.
Restart the app and compare the event time again.

title: Rebuild the workspace search index
steps: Open Admin > Search > Maintenance.
Start a full index rebuild for the workspace.
Wait for the rebuild to finish, then search for a recent file.

title: Reset the user's two-factor enrollment
steps: Verify the user's identity by the account recovery process.
Reset two-factor enrollment from the user's security page.
Have the user enroll the authenticator app again and log in.

title: Refresh the workspace time zone rules
steps: Open Admin > Calendar > Time zone data and check the rules version.
Apply the current time zone rules to the workspace.
Re-render the affected recurring events and compare two users' views.

title: Resume the document processing queue
steps: Open Admin > Search > Processing and check the queue state.
Resume the paused text extraction queue for the workspace.
Confirm the backlog drains, then search for a recent file.

title: Move the account off the drifting auth node
steps: Check the auth node serving the account for clock drift.
Move the account to a healthy auth node.
Ask the user to try a fresh code.

title: Restore the share link expiry policy
steps: Open Admin > Sharing > Link policy and read the expiry value.
Set the expiry from 0 back to the default 30 days.
Ask the customer to create a new link and open it as a guest.

title: Refund the duplicate proration charge
steps: Open the billing timeline and find the two charges for the plan change.
Refund the duplicate proration charge.
Send the customer the refund receipt.

title: Add the tax ID and regenerate the invoice
steps: Open Billing > Tax details and enter the customer's VAT number.
Regenerate the affected invoice.
Send the corrected invoice to the customer.
